{{Top|leg}}
'''Aturlino''' was a season on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]]. Translated, it meant "the season of heavy rains." The mating season of the [[quizzer]]s occurred after aturlino.
